messages:
Nina C.: Heads-up: Partner ResellerCloud flagged an extra charge on their April AWS Marketplace invoice. Looks like two metering lines for the same usage but different meter keys.

Arjun D.: invoice id and sample lines?

Nina C.: INV-2025-04-11700
Excerpt:
```
Line 202: SUB-4433 | metering.dimension=embedding_ops | qty=4,200 | charge=$210.00
Line 203: SUB-4433 | metering.dimension=embedding_ops_total | qty=4,200 | charge=$210.00
```

Kelsey H.: that's the embedding_ops vs embedding_ops_total pattern. We saw a few of these during the 2025-04-10 ingest window when the AWS notify payload changed naming.

billing-bot: Ingest job marketplace-us-west-2-usage-ingest v2025.04.10 completed. Processed 58,112 events; 18 flagged ambiguous-dimension.

Arjun D.: pulling usage_id trace... one sec.

Arjun D.: usage_id matches, timestamps identical. Not additive. Recommend issuing credit for the secondary line (Line 203) $210.00.

Nina C.: ok prepare credit memo + JE. This partner is on a reseller flow so we need to also notify Channel Ops.

Kelsey H.: creating ChannelOps ticket CH-9002: "Credited duplicate metering dimension for SUB-4433 on INV-2025-04-11700; remediation will dedupe on usage_id+subscription and whitelist primary dims."

billing-bot: Suggested normalization update: dedupe_keys=["usage_id","subscription_id"], primary_dimensions=["embedding_ops","token_usage"]. PR #873 opened in billing-ingest.

Arjun D.: Draft CM: CM-2025-05-021 attached to ticket. Amount $210.00. Emailing accounting now.

Nina C.: tagging accounting for signoff (accounting@redwood.com). Kelsey, please confirm ChannelOps ticket and paste PR link.

Kelsey H.: ticket CH-9002 updated, PR #873 linked. Partner rep confirmed they'll relay to their buyer.

billing-bot: Postmortem created PM-2025-04-embedding-dims assigned to Arjun D., due 2025-05-08.

Nina C.: thanks all. Leaving thread for audit; we'll close after accounting posts JE.

(END)
